Look up Stata text from the editor or clipboard

Source: R/findit-tools.R
findit_selection.Rd

Look up one Stata command using the same catalogue and variable customization as findit(). The result is printed in the console. Source text and clipboard contents are preserved; no command or returned example is executed.

Usage

findit_selection()

findit_clip()

Value

The findit() result, invisibly, after printing it once.

Details

findit_selection() reads highlighted text in the source editor. It is also registered as the Find Stata equivalent addin. It requires the optional rstudioapi package and an editor providing its source-selection API, such as RStudio or a compatible Positron session.

findit_clip() reads text copied to the clipboard, for example from a do-file. It requires the optional clipr package and access to a text clipboard.

See also

findit()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Highlight tab sex region, row in the source editor, then run:
findit_selection()

# Copy tab sex region, row to the clipboard, then run:
findit_clip()
} # }
